Octo

The Octo music player for Android, for your Octo or Navidrome server. Releases come from https://github.com/winters27/octo/releases.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://winters27.github.io/octo/fdroid/repo
